summary: Rabbi Soffer goes through Rashi on Parashat Lech Lecha, focusing on the narrative of Avraham Abinu, the separation of Lot, and the war of the four kings against the five kings. The class examines the geography of the land, the character of the people of Sedom, and the details of the battle and capture of Lot.
questions: Why did the Shekhina stop speaking to Avraham while Lot was with him?
Why does the Torah describe the people of Sedom as evil?
What is the significance of the war of the four kings against the five kings?
Who was the refugee that informed Avraham about Lot's capture?
How does Rashi explain the grammar of the word 'Hera' when the kings fled?
